entities.summary: Johnson, a notable figure in the history of Dominican Republic, associated with Post-Trujillo Democracy and the 1965 Crisis (1961–1966). Their legacy influenced Juan Bosch elected in first free elections 1962 — overthrown after 7 months and US invades Dominican Republic with 42,000 troops — April 1965.
